data.title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 Opens Creative Space with BAB TALK & Workshop
data.description: The Bangkok Art Biennale Foundation recently organised “BAB TALK & Workshop”, an engaging programme inviting participants to explore contemporary art and gain insight into the creative process with Shin Min, a South Korean artist participating in the Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 (BAB 2026). Held under the theme “Angels and Mara”, the event took place at BAB Café, Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC).

data.title: SYMC Accelerates Growth with Four Strategic Drivers
data.description: BANGKOK – Symphony Communication Public Company Limited, or SYMC, has signalled a positive performance outlook for 2026, supported by a continued business recovery and sustained growth. The company is advancing four key Growth Drivers to capitalize on the AI, data centerand digital economy megatrends: accelerating its expansion in the enterprise market; enhancing network capacity to support the growth of AI and datacenters; expanding regional connectivity; and building stable, sustainable growth. These initiatives will enable SYMC to capture long-term opportunities arising from digital infrastructure and enterprise services.

data.title: Siam Piwat Partners with Chinese Leaders to Build Asian Digital Travel Ecosystem
data.description: Bangkok (September 11, 2026) – Siam Piwat ,a leading real estate developer behind world-class landmarks, the owner and operator of Siam Paragon, Siam Center andSiam Discovery, and a joint venture partner of Icosiamand Siam Premium Outlets Bangkok,hasreinforcedits role as a game changer by advancing its “Co-creation & Collaboration to Win” strategy to integrateAsian Digital Travel ecosystem developed in collaboration with Chinese partnersinto its global partnership ecosystem, establishinga new growth platform that opens up business opportunities.

data.title: True Unveils Plan to Connect AI, GHG Emission Platform and Green Financing Readiness
data.description: Customers expect networks to deliver more than speed, supporting both digital lifestyles and businesses in the AI era, from cloud services and IoT devices to homes, factories and smart cities. Delivering better experiences requires collaboration between True and its partners across the supply chain. This spans technology and equipment selection, network development, and the efficient use of energy and resources. GSMA, the global mobile industry association, reports that mobile data traffic in Asia Pacific increased by 350% between 2019 and 2024, while limited access to renewable energy remains a challenge for decarbonization in the region. The key challenge for True and its partners is therefore to keep raising service quality in line with customer demand while improving business efficiency without adding to the environmental burden, so that digital growth can also be sustainable growth.

data.title: Taylor's Schools Enters Thailand as St. Andrews International School Joins the Group
data.description: Taylor's Schools, one of Southeast Asia's leading K-12 education groups, today announced the transition of St. Andrews International School, marking the group's entry into Thailand and its ﬁrst expansion beyond Malaysia and Singapore. The transaction comprises four St. Andrews campuses:Sathorn, Dusit, and Sukhumvit 107 in Bangkok, and Green Valley on Thailand's Eastern Seaboard.

data.title: Vitafoods Asia 2026 highlights growing Norway-Thailand food supplement trade
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand, 11 September 2026– Thailand’s growing focus on health, nutrition and preventive care is creating new opportunities for Norwegian companiesseekingtoestablisha stronger foothold in Southeast Asia, according to theThai-NorwegianChamber of Commerce.

data.title: Dhipaya Insurance Launches TIPSOL, a Universe of Happiness
data.description: Reaffirming its position as a leading insurance brand committed to delivering exceptional experiences for Thai consumers,DhipayaInsurance Public Company Limited, a market leader in Thailand’s non-motor insurance sector, is taking customer engagement to the next level with the launch of “TIPSOL”,its new loyaltyprogramdesigned to extend customer care beyond insurance and into everyday life.

data.title: KOHLER Unveils a New Design and Innovation Destination at Boonthavorn Ratchada
data.description: BANGKOK, THAILAND –KOHLER , the global lifestyle brand renowned for designed bathroom and kitchen products, celebrates the opening of KOHLER New Design Destination atBoonthavornRatchada. Located on Ratchadaphisek Road in Bangkok’s Din Daeng district, the new 220m showroom invites visitors to explore a more immersive and inspiring way to discover design.

data.title: Central Pattana Wins ICSC MAXI Award 2026 for Thai Heritage Christmas Trees
data.description: Central Pattana brings Thai creativity to the global stage as the Only Thai Company to win at the ‘2026 ICSC GLOBAL MAXI AWARDS’ in the US with ‘11 One-of-a-Kind Christmas Trees’ rooted in Thai heritage

data.title: Pataya Food Group Partners with Japan’s Umios to Drive Asian Growth
data.description: BANGKOK — Pataya Food Group (PFG) , owner of Nautilus, Mongkut Talay, Sea Crown, Regalos, and Remy, announces a strategic partnership with Umios Corporation (Japan) to accelerate growth across Asia. The alliance combines PFG’s strengths in brand building and channel management with Umios Group’s global network and industry expertise. Together, the companies aim to support PFG's ambition of achieving average annual growth of 10% , guided by the shared mission of “Enrich People's Life.”

data.title: How Homprung by Baihor is reimagining Thailand’s herbal heritage through contemporary art
data.description: In Bangkok Old Town, where generations of history and traditional knowledge remain embedded in everyday life, a contemporary herbal space is creating a new way to encounter Thailand’s cultural heritage.

data.title: Siam Global House Expands BESS Across Thailand
data.description: BANGKOK, Aug 31, 2026 — Siam Global House Public Company Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with AESCON Co Ltd and Integra R.E. Co Ltd to jointly develop and deploy Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions across its branch network, marking a significant step toward smarter and more resilient energy management across its operations. The MOU was signed at Huawei’s Digital Power Hall headquarters in Shenzhen, China.

data.title: Betagro Unveils Mascot 'BeBie' for 59th Anniversary 'Shaping Our Future' Campaign
data.description: Bangkok–11September 2026–BetagroPublic Company Limited(BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, celebrated its 59 thanniversary of pride under the theme“Shaping Our Future",reflecting its journey of growth and strong commitment to building a better future.

data.title: STGT Unveils Future of Gloves at IRGCE 2026, Setting Global Clean World Standard
data.description: Sri Trang Gloves (Thailand) Public Company Limited (STGT), a global leader in sustainable rubber glove manufacturing and distribution, is reinforcing its role in shaping the future of the rubber glove industry on the international stage through its participation in the 12th International Rubber Glove Conference & Exhibition (IRGCE 2026), held at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, Malaysia, from 8 – 10 September 2026. At the event, STGT highlighted its “Clean World Clean Gloves” (CWCG) concept as a key framework for elevating industry standards beyond product quality and performance to encompass transparency, responsibility, and sustainability throughout the entire value chain.

data.title: “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026” elevates Bangkok as a global watch destination
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand — Siam Paragon, reaffirming its position as a global landmark and one of the world’s premier Global Luxury Destinations, is set to host a defining landmark of haute horology with the second edition of “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026.” The event is a “Celebration of Watch Culture,” bringing new depth and perspective to the world of horology through an exceptional gathering of more than 45 prestigious international watch maisons, renowned industry leaders, discerning collectors and passionate enthusiasts from across the globe.

data.title: Siam Piwat and WFP Partner to Deliver 100,000 Meals for Food Security
data.description: Because every meal has the power to create a meaningfuldifference andimpact, Siam Piwat Group has joined hands with the United Nations World FoodProgramme(WFP) to launch “The Next Bucket: Save Lives & Change Lives”.Theinitiative invites everyone to share the power of giving through food, supporting WFP’s mission toassistpeopleand communities affected by crises and food insecurity across Asiaand thePacific.

data.title: SCGD Targets 4.5B EBITDA and 2x EPS by 2031, Driving ASEAN Growth via Thailand-Vietnam Strengths
data.description: SCG Decor Public Company Limited (SCGD), a leader in decorativesurfaceand sanitaryware in ASEAN, is moving forward into the next phase of its growth towardsbecoming a fully integrated leader in interior products in ASEAN. This follows three years in which the company has laid a strong business foundation, including improving operational efficiency and restructuring andconsolidatingproduction for its core tile and sanitaryware businesses. The company has set a target for 2031 to raise EBITDA to 4,500 millionbahtand to grow earnings per share (EPS) by two times, through three key strategies: expansion into new product businesses, profit enhancement through production consolidation in ASEAN, and capturing growth opportunities in Vietnam, alongside positioning Vietnam as the region's production and export hub.

data.title: Merz Aesthetics Hosts “PRI’ME THE FUTURE SYMPOSIUM 2026”
data.description: Bangkok – 2 September 2026 – Merz Aesthetics, the world’s largest dedicated medical aesthetics business, hosted “PRI’ME THE FUTURE SYMPOSIUM 2026” at Dusit Thani Bangkok, a major regional Ultherapy PRIME symposium bringing together more than 370 partners, healthcare professionals and experts from across Asia-Pacific, including Thailand, South Korea, Australia, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam and India. The symposium provided a platform to exchange knowledge, clinical experience and perspectives on innovation, while exploring new directions and collectively shaping the future of the aesthetic medicine industry.

data.title: "A Culture of Light, Shadow and Flowing Stream" Art Exhibition Opens at Siam Paragon
data.description: “ACulture of Light, Shadow and Flowing Stream”is an art exhibition that celebrates the beauty of Thai culture through the integration ofphotography, painting, and sculpture. Using“light and shadow”as an artistic language, the exhibition reflects the continuous“flow” of culture, much like ariver that is never still.

data.title: Thailand Coaching Summit to explore human roles in AI era
data.description: The Thailand Coaching Summit 2026 will bring together leading executives, organisational development professionals and coaching experts to explore the evolving role of coaching leadership, human-AI collaboration and sustainable high-performance cultures. Taking place on Nov 11 at Thammasat Association, Bangkok, the summit will be held under the theme “Building a Coaching Culture for Modern Organizations.”

data.title: BMW Group Thailand, Master Car Rental prep 250+ vehicles for major international conference
data.description: Bangkok. BMW Group Thailand, in partnership with Master Car Rental, operating as SIXT Thailand, announced a significant collaboration to prepare and provide a premium fleet of over 250 BMW vehicles to the Ministry of Finance. These vehicles will serve as the official mobility fleet for world leaders and delegates attending a major international conference later this year.
